title: Branch Manager
description:
**We’re hiring | Branch Head | AXN Infotech Pvt Ltd**

**Location: TIRUPUR**

At AXN, a Branch Head leads both sales and service. You’ll be accountable for branch revenue, team performance and customer retention. You’ll also work directly with business owners and accountants to understand where they lose time and show them how Tally products and AXN’s value-added products and services can help.

Key responsibilities

* Grow branch revenue. Set monthly sales targets, build a pipeline of qualified opportunities and review progress with the team each week.
* Win new customers. Generate business through direct outreach to local MSMEs, auditor referrals, channel partners and business associations.
* Lead solution sales. Meet customers, understand their workflows and demonstrate relevant solutions. This could mean helping an accountant automate a manual report or helping a business owner connect sales and accounting. Lead key proposals and negotiations through to closure.
* Retain and grow existing accounts. Work with the renewals team on Tally Software Services (TSS) and annual maintenance contracts (AMCs). Stay close to key customers and identify additional needs as their businesses grow.
* Develop the branch team. Set individual goals, coach team members through joint customer visits and demonstrations, and use CRM data to address missed follow-ups and stalled deals.
* Own branch operations and service delivery. Coordinate sales, service and technical teams so every customer commitment has an owner and a delivery date. Resolve escalations and report branch performance to management.

Experience and skills

* At least 3 years of experience in sales, business development or branch management, including experience leading a team.
* A track record of achieving revenue targets and acquiring new customers.
* Strong customer communication, product demonstration and negotiation skills.
* Working knowledge of CRM software, Microsoft Excel and sales reporting.
* Experience selling Tally, ERP, SaaS or other business software to MSMEs is preferred.

About AXN Infotech

**AXN Infotech is a Five-Star Tally Solution Provider serving more than 20,000 customers. We help businesses simplify their operations through Tally customisation, software integrations, CRM applications, WhatsApp automation and industry-specific solutions.**

To apply, send me your CV via LinkedIn message with “Branch Head” and your city. Include one measurable result you achieved while leading a sales or branch team.
